title: Test densities and distributional sections of smooth real bundles
statement: Over $\mathbf R$ [def-weil-field], let $N$ be a compact Hausdorff second-countable oriented smooth manifold without boundary of dimension $m\geq1$ [def-sfb-smooth-real-manifold], and $E\to N$ a smooth finite-rank real vector bundle [def-sfb-smooth-real-vector-bundle]. An orientation is a choice of compatible charts with positive transition Jacobian determinants. Use smooth sections [def-sfb-smooth-bundle-sections], the fibrewise dual $E^*$ [def-sfb-smooth-dual-bundle], the density line $\mathrm{Dens}_N=|\Lambda^mT^*N|$ [def-sfb-smooth-density-line], and the fibrewise tensor bundle [def-sfb-smooth-tensor-bundle]. Put $\mathcal T(E)=\Gamma_c^\infty(E^*\otimes\mathrm{Dens}_N)$ with the chart/frame seminorm topology of [def-sfb-compact-smooth-section-topology]. Define $\mathcal D'(E)=\mathcal T(E)'_b$ using [def-sfb-real-strong-dual]: this is the continuous real-linear dual with seminorms $u\mapsto\sup_{\phi\in S}|u(\phi)|$ for sets $S$ bounded for every test-space seminorm. A smooth section $s$ gives $\phi\mapsto\int_N\phi(s)$: take the chart-sum integral of [def-sfb-smooth-density-integral], choosing a partition by [lem-sfb-smooth-subordinate-partition]; its choice independence and linearity are [lem-sfb-density-integral-choice-independent], and continuity of this pairing is [lem-sfb-smooth-section-pairing-continuous]. For a smooth real function $h$, define $hu\in\mathcal D'(E)$ by $(hu)(\phi)=u(h\phi)$, using continuity of $M_h$ from [lem-sfb-test-operations-continuous]. In a chart $x:U\to V$ and frame $e$ of $E$, set $u_{x,e}=u\circ J_{x,e}\in\mathscr D(V,\mathbf R^q)'_b$, where the local tests are [def-sfb-local-coefficient-tests] and $J_{x,e}$ is the continuous chart-density extension of [lem-sfb-test-operations-continuous]. For $\alpha\in\mathbf N^m$, define the local coefficient distribution $\partial^\alpha u_{x,e}\in\mathscr D(V,\mathbf R^q)'_b$ by $(\partial^\alpha u_{x,e})(f)=(-1)^{|\alpha|}u_{x,e}(\partial^\alpha f)$; repeated use of [lem-sfb-local-test-derivative-continuous] makes the test operator continuous. This derivative belongs to the chart coefficient dual, with the specified chart and frame. For another such bundle $F$ and a specified continuous real-linear map $T:\mathcal T(F)\to\mathcal T(E)$, define its transpose $T':\mathcal D'(E)\to\mathcal D'(F)$ by $(T'u)(\phi)=u(T\phi)$.
